title: Crestline Fleet Account Late Charge, Credit Hold and Collections Figures
content:
These program figures govern late charges and credit status on a Crestline Fleet Account. Amounts are in USD.

## Late charges

| Program | Late charge on the past-due balance at each month-end (percent per month) | Smallest late charge assessed when any is due | Invoiced under the agency's own prompt-payment schedule instead of late charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 1.5 | 5.00 | no |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 1.5 | 5.00 | no |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 1.5 | 5.00 | no |
| Crestline Fleet National | 1.25 | 5.00 | no |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 1.0 | 5.00 | no |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 0 | 0.00 | yes |

A monthly late-charge percentage of 0 means no late charge. On every program the balance the late charge applies to is the balance past due at month-end.

## Credit hold and collections

| Program | Days past the oldest unpaid invoice's due date at which the account goes on credit hold | How far above the credit limit the balance may run before credit hold (percent of the limit) | Days past due at which a held account is closed and referred to collections |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 30 | 0 | 90 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 30 | 5 | 90 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 45 | 5 | 120 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 45 | 10 | 120 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 60 | 10 | 120 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 90 | 0 | 180 |

## Closed accounts

On every program a balance on a closed account stays due on its existing terms.

## Reading the tolerance (hypothetical figures)

On a hypothetical Crestline Fleet National account with a credit limit of 60000.00, the tolerance of 10 percent of the limit is 6000.00, so the balance may run up to 66000.00 before the over-limit condition is met; on Crestline Fleet Starter and Crestline Fleet Public Sector the tolerance is 0, so any balance above the limit itself meets it.
